name: Thai Chicken Cashew Stir-Fry with Bell Pepper, Bok Choy & Green Onion

instructions.primary_message: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups jasmine rice
3 cup water

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic. Place in a large bowl along with fish sauce, soy sauce, sugar, cornstarch, and spices. Whisk to combine the marinade.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 cloves garlic
¼ cup fish sauce
3 tbsp soy sauce
3 tbsp brown sugar
1 tbsp cornstarch
¾ tsp crushed red pepper
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Medium dice chicken and add to bowl with the marinade. Stir to coat and set aside.
While the chicken is marinating, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 yellow bell peppers
9 baby bok choy
1 small bunch green onions (scallions)

instructions.primary_message: Using a clean cutting board, trim, seed, and slice bell peppers lengthwise into thin strips. Place in another large bowl.
Trim and cut bok choy crosswise into ½-inch strips. Add to the bowl with the bell pepper.
Trim and cut green onions crosswise into 1-inch pieces. Add to the bowl and set aside.
Preheat a large pot over medium heat.

Once the pot is hot, add oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Using a slotted spoon, add chicken to the pot, leaving the marinade in the bowl. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the chicken is golden brown, 6-7 minutes. (Reserve marinade for the next step.)
Add the veggies, reserved marinade, and water to the pot. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies are tender and sauce has thickened, 4-5 minutes more. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide rice and stir-fry between plates or bowls; sprinkle with cashews. Enjoy!
